notes.title: The Patient - Prologue
notes.content:
REQUEST ACCESS

The Patient is a classic escape game in ego perspective where you find yourself in a Sanatorium in the 1930s. Explore the mysterious location and solve cunning Puzzles to progress further. But stay alert, you are not alone! Will you be able to find your way out?

PLEASE LEAVE YOUR FEEDBACK IN THE DISCUSSIONS !
